# Awesome Game Prompts

> Public AI game-art workflows, tested prompts, and visual references for character design, concept art, UI, VFX, and 3D production.

## Character production workflow

The six-stage workflow turns one character reference into a complete source, design breakdown, orthographic turnaround, rigging pose, controlled variants, and neutral-gray 3D handoff reference. Each stage includes an acceptance gate. The page also includes an orchestration prompt designed for a tool-using model such as GPT-6 Astra.

## Evidence boundary

Example images on the site come from separate prompt records, not one end-to-end character run, so they do not prove cross-stage consistency. The GPT-6 Astra section is an orchestration blueprint and is not presented as a completed model benchmark.
